text: Speaker 3 Things started so well. We got to the airport in good time and did a bit of shopping in duty-free. The flight took off and landed on time, so there were no transport problems for once. Then things started to change. My friend and I couldn't agree on what to do or where to go. We spent so long planning that we didn't see much of the local area. I wanted to learn about local history, visiting the castle, Roman ruins, things like that. Sally wanted to go shopping and hang out at the theme park, my idea of hell. In the end, we didn't stop arguing all week. I was so relieved to get home.
